textSections.content: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC), Prayagraj Are Released Uttar Pradesh Primary Teacher UP Primary Teacher Examination 2026. Candidate Can Apply Between 16/09/2026 to 15/10/2026. | Candidate Read the Notification Before Apply the Recruitment Application Form in UP Primary Teacher Exam Advt No 05/2026. | Kindly Check and Collect the All Document – Eligibility, ID Proof, Address Details, Basic Details. | Kindly Ready Scan Document Related to Recruitment Form – Photo, Sign, ID Proof, Etc. | Before Submit the Application Form Must Check the Preview and All Column Carefully. | If Candidate Required to Paying the Application Fee Must Submit. If You have Not the Required Application Fees Your Form is Not Completed. | Take A Print Out of Final Submitted Form. | For the latest updates on , admit card, answer key, and result, always visit , the official website for in India ().

howToApply: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC), Prayagraj Are Released Uttar Pradesh Primary Teacher UP Primary Teacher Examination 2026. Candidate Can Apply Between 16/09/2026 to 15/10/2026
Candidate Read the Notification Before Apply the Recruitment Application Form in UP Primary Teacher Exam Advt No 05/2026
Kindly Check and Collect the All Document – Eligibility, ID Proof, Address Details, Basic Details

faq.question: When did the UPESSC UP Assistant Primary Teacher Online Form 2026 Start?
faq.answer: The online application process started on 16 September 2026.

faq.question: What is the Exam Date for UPESSC UP Primary Teacher Exam 2026 ?
faq.answer: The Examination will be conducted in 03-04 December 2026.

faq.question: Where can I find the syllabus for the UPESSC UP Primary Teacher 2026 Examination?
faq.answer: The detailed syllabus and examination scheme are available in the official notification. Candidates are advised to read the notification carefully for complete details.

faq.question: What is the last date to apply online for UPESSC UP Primary Teacher Online Form 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 19 October 2026..

faq.question: What is the last date to pay the application fee?
faq.answer: Candidates can pay the application fee up to 19 October 2026.

additionalData.neet_ug_code_01: A candidate who is appearing in the qualifying examination, i.e., 12 Standard in 2026 whose result is awaited may apply and take up the said test but he/she shall not be eligible for admission to the MBBS or BDS, if he/she does not pass the qualifying examination with the required pass percentage of marks at the time of first round of Counseling.
additionalData.neet_ug_code_03: The Intermediate/Pre-degree Examination in Science of an Indian University/Board or other recognized examining body with Physics, Chemistry, Biology /Bio-technology (which shall include practical test in these subjects) and also English as a compulsory subject
additionalData.neet_ug_code_04: The Pre-professional/Pre-medical Examination with Physics ,Chemistry, Biology/Bio-technology & English after passing either the Higher Secondary Examination or the Pre-University or an equivalent examination.
